content_fields.title: Protect data in transit with TLS (Database Server)
content_fields.description: Require TLS for all connections to the database server.
content_fields.guidance: The database server should refuse plaintext connections outright, presenting a certificate issued by a known CA, so that no client can negotiate an unencrypted session.
content_fields.found: The stock PostgreSQL image accepts plaintext connections and nothing in the deployment forbids them.
content_fields.missing: Server-side pg_hba.conf entries and certificate material.
content_fields.conclusion: Refusing plaintext is enforced by the database server configuration, outside this repository.
content_fields.action: The database administration team should require hostssl entries and remove plaintext host entries.
